title: SynthID Bio: Watermarking methods for synthetic biology
author: Pushmeet Kohli, David Stutz, Ali Cowen-Rivers and Jeremy Ratcliff
summary_raw: SynthID Bio is a family of watermarking methods developed specifically for synthetic biology to strengthen biosecurity and scientific integrity.
content_text: SynthID Bio is a family of watermarking methods developed specifically for synthetic biology to strengthen biosecurity and scientific integrity.
